sentences.text: The RGSFSAE scheme stands for the Rajiv Gandhi Scheme for Empowerment of Adolescent Girls.
This scheme was launched by the Ministry of Women and Child Development.
It aims to empower adolescent girls aged 11 to 18 years.
The primary objective is to improve their nutritional and health status.
The scheme also focuses on enhancing their educational status and life skills.
Benefits include the provision of nutritional support and health services.
It promotes awareness about health and hygiene among adolescent girls.
The scheme provides life skills training and vocational training.
Eligibility is limited to girls in the age group of 11 to 18 years.
The application process involves registration through local Anganwadi centers.
The scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Women and Child Development.
It is operational across various states and Union Territories in India.
The timeline for the scheme is ongoing and does not have a fixed end date.
The scheme also encourages community participation for better outreach.
